summary.en: Salvadoran forces are now conducting airstrikes and ground assaults against Haitian gang leaders while Haitian police raids in Port-au-Prince have eliminated suspected gang members. A market near the capital was attacked, leaving ten dead and seven injured, and a separate attack killed 47 civilians, prompting a UN condemnation and EU sanctions on four Haitian gangs for serious human rights violations. Bukele has disclosed the deaths of El Salvador troops operating in Haiti. The conflict produced 193 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Salvadoranske styrker gjennomfører nå luftangrep og bakkestøt mot haitiske gjengledere, mens haitisk politi i Port-au-Prince har gjennomført razziaer som har fjernet mistenkte gjengmedlemmer. Et marked i nærheten av hovedstaden ble angrepet, og ti personer ble drept og syv såret, og et separat angrep drepte 47 sivile, noe som førte til en FN-fordømmelse og EU-sanksjoner mot fire haitiske gjenger for alvorlige brudd på menneskerettighetene. Bukele har kunngjort dødsfallene blant El Salvadors tropper som opererer i Haiti. Konflikten førte til 193 kamprelaterte dødsfall i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Haitian conflict
background.extract: Since 2020, Haiti's capital Port-au-Prince has been the site of an ongoing armed conflict between rival gangs and the state. The government of Haiti and national security forces have struggled to maintain their control of Port-au-Prince amid this conflict, with gangs speculated to control up to 90% of the city by 2023. In response to the escalating fighting, an armed vigilante movement, known as bwa kale, also emerged, with the purpose of fighting the gangs. On 2 October 2023, United Nations Security Council Resolution 2699 was approved, authorizing a Kenya-led "multinational security support mission" to Haiti. Until 2024, the war was between two major groups and their allies: the Revolutionary Forces of the G9 Family and Allies and the G-Pèp. However, in February 2024 the two rival groups united in a coalition known as Viv Ansanm, formed to oppose the government and the UN mission.
